messages:
olivia: Quick follow-up after the postmortem: we need a compact runbook + playbook edits for the eviction cascade we saw. Goal: clear triage steps, exact commands for oncall, and owners. Keep this thread short.

grant: I'll draft the runbook TL;DR and triage checklist. Will include a 'collect then mitigate' pattern: collect metrics -> check KV state -> decide rollback or throttle. Owner: @grant. ETA 2024-12-02.

nina: I'll add the exact commands to collect artifacts. Snippets:```
# collect runtime pod list and logs
kubectl -n redwood get pods -l app=runtime -o wide > /tmp/runtime_pods.txt
kubectl -n redwood logs runtime-0 -c runtime --since=10m > /tmp/runtime_logs.txt
# dump KV cache stats
curl -s http://127.0.0.1:9090/debug/kv > /tmp/kv_stats.json
```

yash: For mitigation commands, include a quick throttle and fallback switch. Example:```
# temporarily lower max_seq
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://console.redwood.dev/api/v1/runtime/config -d '{"max_seq":1024}'
# switch route to fallback variant
redwoodctl routing set --route=chat-api --variant=fallback --force --note "emergency fallback"
```

claire: I'll own the escalation matrix and the alert rule change. Draft alert (Prometheus):```
- alert: EvictionCascadeHighP95
  expr: (rate(runtime_errors_total[5m]) > 0.015) and (histogram_quantile(0.95, rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) > 0.9)
  for: 4m
  labels:
    severity: page
  annotations:
    summary: "Potential eviction cascade: errors + p95 spike"
    runbook: "https://docs.redwood.internal/runbooks/eviction-cascade"
```
Owner: @claire. Due 2024-12-04.

olivia: Nice. Let's create tracked tickets so PM and Ops can follow up. Grant, please open RW-INC-5230 for runbook edits. Nina RW-INC-5231 for diag commands. Yash RW-INC-5232 for mitigation commands + test plan. Claire RW-INC-5233 for alerts & escalation.

grant: Will create RW-INC-5230 and link back here. Adding reviewers: @nina + @claire.

nina: I'll add a small reproduction snippet to RW-INC-5231 (payload shape + sequence length pattern) so ML/product can validate triggers.

yash: For rollout mitigation, recommend 3-step safe rollback: 0% -> 10% (10m) -> 50% (20m) -> 100% with automated gating. I'll add the gating hooks in RW-INC-5232.

claire: Also add a 90-day verification cadence: weekly checks month 1, biweekly month 2, monthly month 3. I'll attach calendar invites once tickets are created.

oncall-bot: Reminder: runbook/playbook PR needs 2 approvers (SRE + Runtime). I will post reminders 48h before due dates.

grant: Summary actions here so QA/PM can follow:
- grant: runbook TL;DR + triage checklist  due 2024-12-02  RW-INC-5230
- nina: diag commands + repro snippet  due 2024-11-30  RW-INC-5231
- yash: mitigation commands + gating test plan  due 2024-12-02  RW-INC-5232
- claire: alert rule + escalation matrix + calendar cadence  due 2024-12-04  RW-INC-5233

olivia: I'll update the postmortem doc with these owners and ticket links by EOD. If anything changes post here.

nina: PR draft will have the shell of the commands; ping me for missing creds.

yash: I'll add canary test checklist (synthetic load qps, seq distribution, kv hit-rate checks).

claire: LGTM. Adding reviewers now.

oncall-bot: Reminders scheduled. Thread will be archived after 72h of inactivity.

oglivia: thanks all (typo) :-)
